_about: Dataset-level metadata for the Haley V2 import (stage 2). Sources: the eLife paper (Haley, Chen, Aoi, Chalasani, eLife 13:RP103191, doi:10.7554/eLife.103191; Key resources table, Materials and methods, Funding, Author contributions, Author ORCIDs, Data availability) and the NDI Cloud dataset page (licence). ROR ids came from web search and are marked '_verify' where the search result was not titled with the organization's name. Every entry has a local `key`; references between entries use keys, which the maker resolves to document ids. See import_V2_decisions.md.

formulations._note: 240102B_NGM_plates (Benchling; Kathleen Quach, adapted from WormBook): one batch, 25 mL per 100 mm plate.
S Medium in WormBook; made by the Salk media kitchen. The diluent for every Matching seeding (decision #56).
WormBook's LB (5 g NaCl per litre, the Lennox form); made by the Salk media kitchen.
OP50-GFP is grown and diluted in it (231229_OP50_OP50-GFP_cultures: 300 uL of 50 mg/mL per 150 mL).

instruments.description: Fluorescence stereo microscope used for the E. coli lawn imaging.

instruments.name: Temperature probe
instruments.description: The probe at the behaviour rigs that read the temperature and humidity of each recording (experimentInfo `temp`, `humidity`); make and model not recorded.

environment.notes: The probe's mean over the recording, noted by hand.

studies.name: Single-density, multi-patch assay
studies.description: Four young adult hermaphrodites forage in a 30 mm arena on an isometric grid of 19 patches (0.5 µl, 6 mm apart), all of one OP50 density (OD600 0-10; also 1 (12H) and 1 (48H) grown patches); 1 h at 3 fps.

studies.name: Large, single-patch assay
studies.description: As the single-density multi-patch assay, but one large 20 µl patch in the centre of the 30 mm arena.

studies.name: Small, single-patch assay
studies.description: One young adult in a 9 mm arena with one 0.5 µl patch (OD600 0, 0.5, 1, 5, 10); 1 h at 8 fps and ~105 px/mm, head and tail tracked.

studies.name: Multi-density, multi-patch assay
studies.description: Grids of 18 patches combining OD600 1, 5 and 10 on peptone-free NGM; animals released from an S-Complete droplet at the arena centre; 2 h recordings.

studies.name: Mutant screen and food deprivation (single-density, multi-patch)
studies.description: Single-density, multi-patch environments with ten mutant strains and N2, well-fed and 3-h food-deprived. The paper's food-deprivation analysis is the N2 subset; most strains are not reported in the paper.

studies.name: Sensory mutants (single-density, multi-patch)
studies.description: Wild type (N2) and the sensory mutants osm-6 (PR811) and mec-4 (TU253) in single-density, multi-patch environments.

studies.name: Bacterial patch density estimation
studies.description: OP50-GFP patches seeded as in the behaviour assays and imaged for several hours on a Zeiss Axio Zoom.V16 to estimate relative bacterial density from the patch-edge fluorescence.

dataset.name: Accept-reject decision-making revealed via a quantitative and ethological study of C. elegans foraging
dataset.description: All raw (behaviour videos, fluorescence microscopy images) and processed (animal and bacterial patch locations over time) data for Haley et al., eLife (2025).

transfer_protocol._about: How and when the worms were moved onto each assay plate -- an import directive (decision #52), not dataset metadata. The transfer time is not recorded: on a plate whose 'contrast' (lawn) video was filmed AFTER the worms went on, the transfer is taken as that video's start; otherwise as the first behaviour video's start; approximate either way. Methods: the eLife paper, Assay preparation and recording (agar plugs; eyelash pick into an S-Complete droplet for multi-density). Contrast-video order: from the gap between each plate's lawn clip and its recording, checked by eye in the videos, 2026-10-02 (Matching day 1, 2023-02-24, is worms first; days 2-3 lawn first).
transfer_protocol._max_before: T is read off the first video after the transfer, so the transfer was at most this long before it (Jess Haley, 2026-10-02: 5 min; 10 would be big). On a lawn-first plate the lawn clip's end bounds it more tightly when closer.
transfer_protocol._hand_written: Pick (growthTimePicked) and food-deprivation (starvedTime) times were read off a clock -- possibly analog (e.g. an Apple Watch face) -- and written to the minute: +/- 60 s covers a truncated digital reading and a by-eye analog one (Jess Haley, 2026-10-02).

seeding._about: Stage 8 part B (decisions #56, #57): which strain and diluent each study's seeding suspensions used. Read by ndi.setup.conv.haley.seedingSuspensions. Acclimation (growth) plates were all seeded the same way, 200 uL at OD600 1 in LB (the paper; Jess, 2026-10-03: Matching's too), so a growth seeding uses that day's LB solution: its own study's, else another study's (Matching's days have Mini's).

preparation._about: Stage 8 part C (decisions #54, #56, #57): how the plates were prepared and the worms moved, read by ndi.setup.conv.haley.manipulationDocuments. Every value is from the eLife paper's Methods, the lab's Benchling protocols or Jess Haley; terms are names until the ontology lookup.

pour._about: Every plate is 25 mL of NGM in a 100 mm dish (240102B_NGM_plates; Jess: Mini's too). The agar is NGM, or NGM without peptone where the plate's `peptone` says so (Matching, E. coli); acclimation and food deprivation plates have no `peptone` column and are the plain recipe.

notes.ecoli: The NGM entry for this pour records no antibiotic. Carbenicillin was probably added (the NGM protocol requires an antibiotic for plasmid-carrying bacteria such as OP50-GFP) but is unrecorded (Jess Haley, 2026-10-02).

seed._about: One dose per patch at the patch's volume (`lawnVolume`) and OD600; one per acclimation plate, 200 uL (the paper: 'one large patch of 200 µl of OD600 = 1'). The suspension is the day's (seedingSuspensions).

temperature._about: The temperature a plate was moved INTO, not heat applied; approximate, no tolerance (no bound is known). Cold room ~4 C, room temperature 20 C (the paper: 'stored at 20C until the experiment'); acclimation and food deprivation plates go into the 20 C incubator when the worms are put on them.
temperature._methods: How the temperature was imposed (Jess, 2026-10-03): the method is what tells the uncontrolled bench (ambient exposure) from the controlled 20 C incubator (incubation).
temperature._out_before_seeding: An E. coli plate left the cold room shortly before it was seeded: the paper seeds onto cold, low-moisture NGM plates (Methods, Bacterial cultures), and Jess puts it at about 5 min. So the cold-room window after pouring ends at the seeding time, approximate, up to this much earlier (plus the seeding time's own hand-written bound).

transfer._about: One term_manipulation per move, on the cohort, at its contained_in relation's time. The variable is the cohort's location and the value the kind of plate moved to (the plate itself is the parent of the contained_in relation at the same time); the method the move's last step (onto a food deprivation plate: agar plug, per Jess); every move onto an assay plate first went through an empty NGM plate for about a minute to shed bacteria (Jess, 2026-10-02).
transfer.cleaning: agar plug onto an empty NGM plate for about 1 min, to shed bacteria

developmental_stage._about: One term_observation per cohort (decision #69, Jess 2026-10-08): the worms were chosen as L4 larvae by eye when picked onto the acclimation plate. At the pick's time (hand-written, with its tolerance), or, with no pick time, a relative time before the cohort's next move. Distributive: it holds of each worm. No stage at the assay: it follows from the pick and assay times. Names alone until the terms are looked up (termInventory lists them).
